description: Abstract base class for SignalMapper implementations; provides common logic for mapping signals to Adaptable objects, including payload and header customization points.

classes.name: AbstractSignalMapper
classes.description: Provides a base implementation for SignalMapper classes, handling the common process of mapping signals to Adaptable objects with customizable extension points.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a given signal to an Adaptable object, handling payload and header preparation, with optional validation and enhancement.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the appropriate topic path for a given signal and channel.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Default validation method for signals; does nothing by default, can be overridden.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Extension point for customizing the payload builder based on the signal.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Creates and returns headers for the Adaptable, including Ditto-specific content type headers.
